repository_integrity_technical_fix.cause: Pinned external AbacusSummit docs paths in b6 prereg were incorrectly interpreted as local repository files by generic checker.
repository_integrity_technical_fix.correction: Exact external docs repo+commit+source file paths now verified and excluded from local-file existence check only for exact immutable b6 prereg; previous prereg unchanged.

source_documented_physical_limits.secondary_z095_output: Halo_info and halo particle subsample PID only; full corresponding halo particle RV/field products not provided as primary-redshift outputs.
source_documented_physical_limits.N_meaning: L1 CompaSO halo assigned particle count; N*ParticleMassHMsun is L1 catalog mass, NOT M200c
source_documented_physical_limits.L1_SO_threshold: SODensityL1 relative to cosmic mean density, not fixed 200 times critical
source_documented_physical_limits.SO_radius: distance to furthest assigned SO particle or special sentinel if crossing not reached; not always exact crossing
source_documented_physical_limits.centers: SO_central_particle and x_L2com different center definitions
source_documented_physical_limits.raw_position_radius_units: unit simulation box for nonratio raw fields; abacusutils multiplies by BoxSize to comoving Mpc/h
source_documented_physical_limits.raw_catalog_columns: separate ASDF compressed binary block for each column; schema descriptors can be read without array values
source_documented_physical_limits.abacusutils_cleaned_default: cleaned=True requires unavailable separate cleaned products, prohibited in this gate
